title: Menagerie crawler operator requeue grant v1
description: One tool-minted operator requeue grant. Historically the requeue-grants ledger was the one hand-appended canonical ledger with no schema identity (docket T2-12); rows minted before this version carry no schema_version and remain readable forever. The grant_id content hash covers the operator authorization facts (generation, stable_id, stage, reason, attempts, granted_by, and target_intent when present) and is recomputed on every read; schema_version is deliberately outside that preimage so stamping it never broke an existing identity.

grant_id.description: Canonical grant identity, the one preimage owned by menagerie.crawler.grant_identity.tool_grant_identity.

stable_id.description: Durable identifier of the granted model.

stage.description: Closed failure stage the grant re-authorizes, or the typed deferred-terminal sentinel for review-held null-stage deferrals (docket T2-05).

attempts.description: Author-session extension the granted work generation may spend beyond the base allowance (docket T1-13).

granted_by.description: Operator identity that issued the grant.

new_work_generation.description: One-based ledger append generation allocated at issue time; folded into grant_id.

blocked_award_revision.description: Optional exact runs record revision this grant authorizes superseding (AW-1). Folded into grant_id only when present; the single authority that releases the award-custody tripwire.

target_intent.description: Optional dependency-evidenced environment correction for the new work generation.

capability.description: Optional typed capability this grant authorizes. Only a grant NAMING host-capability-routing may re-open a deferred:needs-more-memory head; a generic requeue never does, because a new work id is not evidence that the host gained memory.
